entries.desc: Inspect pre-story Mechanism Placement Proof architecture document -> contract, lifecycle placement, artifact schemas, gate definitions, freshness rules, stop behavior, rollout steps, test definitions, and B-3783 worked example are fully documented; WHY: Ensures complete pre-story proof specification.

evidence.note: The document includes the explicit pre-allocation artifact input and the surrounding normative architecture, rollout, touchpoints, tests, and worked example.

entries.desc: Check boundary handling between pre-story intake proof vs PLAN verificationIntent and REVIEW/TEST/DONE phase evidence -> intake proof artifact remains strictly separated from post-allocation phase verification evidence; WHY: Prevents lifecycle stage confusion and evidence leakage.

evidence.note: The audited proposal explicitly keeps intake proof candidate-only and separates it from PLAN and delivery evidence.

entries.desc: Simulate missing or unverified pre-story proof artifact during story allocation attempt -> story allocation fails closed with explicit stop behavior; WHY: Guarantees Proof-or-Stop enforcement when mandatory proof is missing or invalid.

evidence.note: The gate result and test matrix require fail-closed no-ID behavior rather than error-text-only checking.

entries.desc: Execute independent Claude CLI and agy CLI architecture audits against draft document -> both CLI audits evaluate duplication, authority boundaries, bypasses, fail-closed behavior, freshness, process-fact registration, rollout safety, and test completeness; WHY: Verifies multi-agent architectural review.

evidence.note: The document records completed independent Claude CLI and agy audits with verified versions.

entries.desc: Reconcile conflicting audit findings between Claude CLI and agy CLI -> all accepted findings are incorporated into the document with clear disposition records for rejected findings; WHY: Ensures complete reconciliation and audit trail integrity.

evidence.note: The audit section contains a single reconciliation table covering every Claude and agy finding and accepted correction.

entries.desc: Attempt to finalize architecture document with un-reconciled CLI audit findings or missing disposition records -> document verification fails validation; WHY: Prevents bypassing independent audit reconciliation controls.
